tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All terms and conditions as per tender document RFP

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Bidder must have completed at least 4 IT eGovernance projects consultancy assignments, each of minimum one year duration and Rs 50 Lakh value during the preceding six years Mandatory. Documents: Work Order Contract and Completion Performance Certificate GST GSTR 3B for private sector assignments.

Bidder must have experience in providing and managing personnel in at least 3 resource categories specified in the tender for at least onecontinuous year Mandatory Documents Work Order Contract completion Performance Certificate client certificate clearly identifying resource categories
Experience in providing IT services resources to State Government Central Government PSU or Government Agency
Experience in managing larger IT resource deployments under a single contract: Minimum 15

Company/Partnership firm registered under applicable Indian law mandatory. Minimum 10 years of operation as on 31.03.2026 Mandatory. Bidder engaged in IT Services IT Consulting IT Consultancy & Support Services Mandatory. Documents: Certificate of Incorporation/Registration and relevant statutory documents
ISO 9001 2015 Mandatory. ISO IEC 27001 2022 Mandatory.CMMi L3 L5 Additional Desirable Documents Valid certificates issued by accredited certification bodies.
Understanding of KMDS requirements Readiness for resource mobilisation Deployment and replacement mechanism Monitoring of resource performance

Minimum average annual turnover of Rs10 Crores in the specified IT IT consulting field during FY 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26 mandatory. additional marks for turnover above the minimum threshold.Documents Audited financial statements, CA certificate and ITRs with UDIN
